title: Horizontal arrangement
summary: Flexbox is suitable for arranging buttons in a row.
tasks: lets .toolbar be arranged horizontally using Flexbox.
sets the spacing between items to 12px and centers the items vertically.
hint: can use display: flex, gap and align-items.
goal: Arrange file operation buttons in a row so that buttons of different heights are vertically centered.

example.note: The order summary lists the order number and status on one line. Even though the status label is taller, the vertical centers of the two items are aligned.
